findings.description: Password inputs for seed backup/restore lack associated <label> elements with htmlFor attributes. Screen readers cannot identify input purpose.
findings.recommendation: Add <label htmlFor="seed-password">Seed Password</label> before each password input with matching id attribute on the input element.

findings.description: When community generation API call fails, an error message is shown but there is no retry button or clear recovery path. Users must manually scroll up, edit and re-submit.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Retry' button next to the error message that re-runs generation without losing form state.

findings.description: If DB save fails during merchant submission, the user still sees the 'Listed!' success screen. The merchant listing only exists locally but user believes it was saved to the database.
findings.recommendation: On DB error, stay on review screen and show an error with retry option. Only proceed to the success screen on actual confirmed save.

findings.description: MetricCard component sets aria-hidden="true" on the actual value div, making metric values invisible to screen readers. Only the container aria-label is readable which provides insufficient context.
findings.recommendation: Remove aria-hidden="true" from content divs. The aria-label on the container (line 181) alone is insufficient when the values inside are hidden.

findings.description: Connection status indicators (green/red dots) rely solely on color to convey connected/disconnected state with no text alternative.
findings.recommendation: Add visually hidden text '(connected)' or '(disconnected)' alongside the colored dot, or use aria-label on the status container.

findings.description: Loading state container has aria-live but the structure is unclear - the live region may not wrap the actual status text correctly, causing screen reader announcements to be missed.
findings.recommendation: Ensure aria-live="polite" and role="status" are on the element that directly contains the dynamic text, not a parent container.

findings.description: Tab keyboard navigation uses document.getElementById to focus next tab but the focus call may target an element not yet in DOM. Arrow key navigation can fail silently.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all tab buttons are always in the DOM. Use refs array instead of getElementById for focus management.

findings.description: Network selector buttons use doubled Tailwind class prefixes: 'border-border-border-default' and 'text-text-text-secondary'. These classes do not exist so the styles fail silently.
findings.recommendation: Change 'border-border-border-default' to 'border-border-default' and 'text-text-text-secondary' to 'text-text-secondary'.

findings.description: Community summary card uses doubled CSS class prefixes: 'text-text-text-secondary' (line 198) and 'bg-bg-bg-elevated' (line 243). These classes do not exist and break visual display.
findings.recommendation: Remove duplicate prefixes: use 'text-text-secondary' and 'bg-bg-elevated'.

findings.description: recordTransaction() can fail silently. If the DB is unavailable during a wallet operation, the user receives no indication that transaction history wasn't saved.
findings.recommendation: Add try-catch with a user-facing toast or error message when transaction recording fails.

findings.description: Connecting to Cashu/Lightning mints has no loading spinner or status message. Users cannot tell if connection is working or stuck.
findings.recommendation: Show a loading state with descriptive text such as 'Connecting to Cashu mint...' during connection attempts.

findings.description: Muted text color (#737373) on dark backgrounds (#0a0a0a, #111111) produces a contrast ratio of approximately 3.8:1, below the WCAG AA minimum of 4.5:1 for normal text. Affects dashboard balance labels, form descriptions and help text.
findings.recommendation: Increase the muted text color from #737373 to #909090 or higher, or replace uses of text-muted with text-secondary in sensitive areas.

findings.description: Metric cards use a fixed height (h-16) but contain long description text that overflows or is cut off on mobile viewports below 640px.
findings.recommendation: Replace h-16 with min-h-[100px] sm:h-16 to allow text wrapping on small screens.

findings.description: Pre blocks with Docker config use max-h-[500px] creating a scroll-within-scroll UX on mobile where the viewport is often less than 800px tall.
findings.recommendation: Make height responsive: max-h-[300px] sm:max-h-[500px] to improve mobile readability.

findings.description: Clicking 'Select' on a community switches context but provides no visual confirmation or loading state, leaving users unsure if the selection was registered.
findings.recommendation: Add temporary visual feedback (brief highlight, spinner, or toast notification) when a community is selected.

findings.description: Seed backup form fields lack required field indicators. Other forms use asterisk + sr-only '(required)' text but this form omits that pattern.
findings.recommendation: Add asterisk visual indicators and sr-only required text to all required fields in the seed backup/restore form.

findings.description: When the Nostr login dropdown opens, focus moves to the first focusable element but there is no focus trap. Tab key can escape the dropdown and focus main page content behind the overlay.
findings.recommendation: Implement a focus trap: when Tab is pressed on the last focusable element, cycle back to the first. Close on Escape key.

findings.description: Tooltips on metric card labels use the HTML title attribute which is only accessible on desktop hover. Mobile users and keyboard users cannot access this information.
findings.recommendation: Replace title attributes with an info icon button that reveals a popover on click/focus, using aria-describedby to associate the tooltip text.

findings.description: Form fields have no inline validation feedback. Errors are only shown on attempting to proceed, not on blur. Users don't know what is required until they hit submit.
findings.recommendation: Show validation errors on blur or as the user types, with red border + error message text below the field.

findings.description: Textarea description field is linked to character counter via aria-describedby but the textarea itself has no aria-label explaining the character limit to screen readers.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-label="Description, maximum 200 characters" to the textarea element.

findings.description: Example prompt buttons have no active/pressed state styling or aria-pressed attribute when a prompt is selected, leaving users unsure which example is active.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-pressed={ex === prompt} attribute and visual indicator (background color or underline) for the selected example.

findings.description: Password fields for seed backup have no strength indicator, minimum length requirement text, or hints about what makes a valid password.
findings.recommendation: Add requirement text like 'Minimum 12 characters' below the field and optionally a strength meter.

findings.description: Expanded/collapsed state of output sections (expandedSection) is local state only. If user expands Docker Compose to review config then refreshes the page, the section collapses and they lose their place.
findings.recommendation: Persist expandedSection to localStorage so users return to the same view state after refresh.

findings.description: Multi-step merchant onboarding requires sequential step completion with no ability to jump to a later step or review summary early.
findings.recommendation: Make step indicator buttons clickable (jumping forward allowed, backward always allowed), with validation still enforced on proceed.

findings.description: 'Copied' confirmation state on copy buttons times out after 2000ms. On slow systems or when users look away, they may miss the confirmation.
findings.recommendation: Keep 'Copied!' state until the next interaction with the button (next click) rather than using a fixed timeout.

findings.description: Navigation links 'Why' and 'Whitepaper' are hidden on mobile with hidden sm:block but there is no hamburger menu or mobile navigation alternative.
findings.recommendation: Add a mobile hamburger menu that reveals navigation links, or keep essential links always visible.

findings.description: Hero heading uses text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl with a large gap between base and sm breakpoints. Text appears too small on tablets in the 640-768px range.
findings.recommendation: Add intermediate breakpoint: text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl.

findings.description: Stats/pillars grid jumps directly from 2 columns (sm) to 5 columns (lg) skipping the tablet range (768-1024px) where 3-4 columns would fit better.
findings.recommendation: Add md breakpoint: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5.

findings.description: Active tab styling uses text-btc-orange on sovereign-panel background. Orange text (#F7931A) on dark panel (#111) produces a contrast ratio around 3.1:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.recommendation: Change active tab text color to white (text-text-primary) for sufficient contrast, using the orange only for the bottom border indicator.

findings.description: Error message text uses text-red-400 on a red-500/10 background, resulting in a contrast ratio of approximately 2.2:1, far below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA requirement.
findings.recommendation: Change error text to text-red-200 or use white text on a solid red background for sufficient contrast.

findings.description: External links (GitHub, Whitepaper) lack aria-label indicating they open in a new tab or window.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-label="GitHub repository (opens in new window)" and consider adding a visual external link icon.

findings.description: No 'Skip to main content' link exists at the top of the page. Keyboard users must tab through the entire navigation bar before reaching main content on every page.
findings.recommendation: Add a visually hidden skip link: Skip to main content and add id="main" to the main content element.

findings.description: prefers-reduced-motion is correctly handled in CSS (lines 180-216), but GSAP scroll animations in app/page.tsx (lines 49-64) may not fully respect the media query.
findings.recommendation: Wrap GSAP animation calls with a check: if (!window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) { /* animate */ }

context.summary: ArxMint has a web_react UI (Next.js 15 / React 19 / Tailwind). The codebase shows good accessibility intentions (aria-live regions, sr-only text, reduced-motion CSS) but has significant gaps. Three critical issues need immediate attention: password inputs in wallet-panel lack labels entirely, failed community generation has no retry path, and merchant submission silently succeeds on DB failure. High-priority issues include broken Tailwind class names with doubled prefixes that silently break styles, metric card values hidden from screen readers via aria-hidden, insufficient color contrast for muted and orange-on-dark text, and missing loading feedback for key operations. Mobile responsiveness is incomplete: nav links disappear without a hamburger menu, grid breakpoints skip tablet ranges, and pre blocks create nested scrolling on mobile. With focused fixes to the 3 critical and 12 high issues, the UX quality would be substantially improved.
